date: Apr 01, 2025; value: 1; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-04-02T01:36:08+08:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a new '### Networking' subsection to the Specification defining a replacement for the EIP-4844 blob-transaction pool wrapper used in PooledTransactions responses: rlp([tx_payload_body, wrapper_version, blobs, commitments, cell_proofs]), with wrapper_version = 1, cell_proofs carrying CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB proofs per blob (extension cells included, blobs sent unextended), the indexing rule cell_proofs[i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + j], and four MUST validation conditions the receiving node applies (equal counts, exact cell-proof count, versioned-hash match, commitment/blob/cell-proof consistency with batch verification). Also repoints the detailed-specification link from consensus-specs specs/_features/eip7594/das-core.md (commit b4188829) to the specs/fulu/ tree (commit 9d377fd5).; Classification rationale: Introduces a new normative wire data structure and validation rules for blob transactions; the first execution-layer-observable requirement in the document.; Confidence: high; Commit: b447dd78664f3b9df005e0987b40b2e97a6c38f2; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b447dd78664f3b9df005e0987b40b2e97a6c38f2; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/b447dd78664f3b9df005e0987b40b2e97a6c38f2

date: Sep 05, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-09-05T21:52:36+08:00; Change type: security_assumption; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Large content expansion ahead of Last Call. Frontmatter: category Networking -> Core and author Alex Stokes (@ralexstokes) added. Replaces the 'TBD' Rationale with five subsections (why DAS scales the DA layer and the 1/8 sampling fraction, what peer sampling provides, why the parameters were chosen, why validators have a custody requirement beyond full nodes, column vs row sampling). Adds a Backwards Compatibility statement ('fully backwards compatible with EIP-4844'), replaces the empty Reference Implementation heading with a Test Cases pointer to the consensus and execution spec tests, and replaces 'Needs discussion' in Security Considerations with a data-withholding analysis including the explicit upper bound P(tricking n*epsilon nodes) <= C(n, n*eps) * C(m, m/2 - 1) * 2^(-k*n*eps) and a table of bounds for 10,000 nodes. Wording touch-ups in the abstract and specification (beacon nodes -> nodes, custody phrasing, wrapper_version emphasis, compute_cells / verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch named).; Classification rationale: Adds the document's security argument and its formal withholding bound, and reclassifies the EIP from Networking to Core. Classified security_assumption because the security analysis is the largest normative-relevant addition; no MUST requirement changed. Medium confidence on the change_type because the commit is a mixed rationale/security/metadata update.; Confidence: medium; Commit: ff212a26b1a4886b18fdf82a48ec4533b60e902a; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ff212a26b1a4886b18fdf82a48ec4533b60e902a; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/ff212a26b1a4886b18fdf82a48ec4533b60e902a

date: May 07, 2025; value: 2; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-05-07T17:56:10+00:00; Change type: interface_or_data_structure; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Renames the consensus-layer configuration field and its keys: `BPO_FORK` -> `BLOB_SCHEDULE`, `epoch` -> `EPOCH`, `max_blobs` -> `MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK`, and updates the matching requirement to read 'The `max` field in `blobSchedule` MUST equal the `MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK` value in the consensus layer configuration'.; Classification rationale: Renames the consensus-layer configuration field and keys that clients must implement, and restates a MUST requirement in the new terms.; Confidence: high; Commit: 954213305aa55eeda61a3fe3fe247011c038a9d4; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/954213305aa55eeda61a3fe3fe247011c038a9d4; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/954213305aa55eeda61a3fe3fe247011c038a9d4

date: Jun 03, 2025; value: 3; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-03T20:23:57+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Largest single expansion of the EIP. Adds author Raul Kripalani (@raulk). Restructures the Specification into Definition / Blob schedule configuration / Execution layer configuration / Consensus layer configuration subsections. Execution layer: each blobSchedule fork is now linked to activation via a top-level `<fork_name>Time` Unix-timestamp field, BPO forks SHOULD be named `bpo<index>` starting at 1, activation timestamps are required only for post-Prague forks, and the illustrative JSON switches from raw-timestamp keys to named osaka/bpo1/bpo2 entries plus cancunTime/pragueTime/osakaTime/bpo1Time/bpo2Time. Adds the rule that a regular hardfork changing these parameters MUST do so by adding a blob schedule entry. Consensus layer: `BLOB_SCHEDULE` is defined as the sequence of blob-parameter changes after ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH, one entry per changing fork. Adds a modified `compute_fork_digest` taking `current_epoch` and `blob_schedule` and XOR-bitmasking `max_blobs_per_block` into the 4-byte digest (returning the base digest when no schedule entry applies). Adds a P2P Networking section: a new ENR entry `nfd` (SSZ Bytes4 ForkDigest, 'next fork digest') that nodes MUST evaluate alongside ENRForkID::next_* fields, a note that `Status` req/resp is unchanged but must carry the updated fork_digest, and a note that gossip topics rotate automatically at a BPO fork. Drops the earlier requirement 'BPO forks MUST NOT conflict with other fork schedules' and changes 'The timestamp in blobSchedule' to 'The slot number in the EL's blobSchedule'.; Classification rationale: Introduces new normative networking behaviour (fork-digest computation, ENR field, peer evaluation), a new activation-timestamp configuration mechanism, and removes one previously stated MUST NOT requirement.; Confidence: high; Commit: f37240a9aec671a46dd0e40b542eed02ddbe7d6a; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/f37240a9aec671a46dd0e40b542eed02ddbe7d6a; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/f37240a9aec671a46dd0e40b542eed02ddbe7d6a

date: Jun 11, 2025; value: 4; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-06-12T01:08:03+08:00; Change type: parameter; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a fourth managed parameter `maxBlobsPerTx` (maximum blobs per transaction) to the abstract, the managed-parameter list and the illustrative blobSchedule JSON (osaka 6, bpo1 12, bpo2 12), with the requirement that the field is optional, defaults to `max` when omitted, and is not used by the consensus layer. Adds a 'Transaction Pool considerations' subsection stating that transactions exceeding a post-BPO-fork blob count MUST NOT be propagated and should be considered for eviction. Also changes the illustrative osaka entry from target 9 / max 12 to target 6 / max 9.; Classification rationale: Adds a new configurable protocol parameter and a new MUST NOT propagation rule for the transaction pool.; Confidence: high; Commit: 79adba6a17513f273085dabeba988f495821653d; Source: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/79adba6a17513f273085dabeba988f495821653d; source_url: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/commit/79adba6a17513f273085dabeba988f495821653d

The same commit adds the equivalent requirement (a limit of 6 blobs per transaction that clients MUST enforce) to EIPS/eip-7594.md, so the requirement moves from EIP-7892 to EIP-7594.; Classification rationale: Removes a configurable parameter and a MUST NOT propagation rule from this EIP; the requirement is relocated to EIP-7594 by the same commit. date: Oct 06, 2025; value: 6; semantic_effect: substantive; Committed (UTC): 2025-10-06T21:45:52+08:00; Change type: normative_behavior; Semantic effect: substantive; Summary: Adds a new '### Blob base fee computations' subsection that modifies the EIP-4844 functions `get_base_fee_per_blob_gas` and `calc_excess_blob_gas` to take a `BlobSchedule` argument (target, max, base_fee_update_fraction) and to use the *current* block's blob schedule, following the precedent set by EIP-7691 for BLOB_BASE_FEE_UPDATE_FRACTION. `TARGET_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK` is removed and replaced by `GAS_PER_BLOB * blob_schedule.target`. Python pseudocode for both functions is included.; Classification rationale: Changes the state-transition functions that compute blob gas pricing, replacing a protocol constant with a schedule lookup; directly affects execution-client implementation.
